title: fuzzpot JSONL log line
description: Contract shared by go-fuzzpot (producer) and fuzz-sec-intel (consumer). This file is byte-identical in both repositories; contract tests in both repos validate against it. Changing it requires coordinated commits in both repos.

v.description: Schema version. Lines written before versioning exist lack this field and are treated by consumers as v1-compatible.

ts.description: Event timestamp, RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 with timezone offset.

printable.description: Printable-ASCII rendering of the payload (may be empty).

hex.description: Lowercase hex dump of the full payload; omitted when log_hex_payload is disabled.

payload_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw payload (64 lowercase hex chars); omitted only in very old producers.
